hero.titleHtml: What actually helps your mitochondria? Rated by the evidence, not the hype.
hero.lead: Mitochondria power nearly every cell in your body: they turn food and oxygen into the energy that runs your heart, brain and muscles. Their slow decline is linked to fatigue, aging, and diseases from Alzheimer's to heart failure, which makes knowing what actually helps them worth getting right. This site rates 87+ foods, drugs, supplements and lifestyle habits, sleep, exercise, fasting, sauna, cold exposure and more, for evidence, benefit and safety, plus VDAC1 research explained in plain language.
